metadata.scope: Saddle clamps, pipe clamps, V-blocks, T-slot strap clamps, drill jigs, toggle clamp bases.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined V-blocks, jig plates, and clamp bodies
material_suggestions.notes: Easy to machine; hard-anodise working faces for wear.

material_suggestions.use_case: strap clamps and toggle clamp frames
material_suggestions.notes: Through-harden working jaws to HRC 45 for long life.
PA12 for functional; add brass inserts for clamping screws.

standards_used.name: ISO 286-1
standards_used.applies_to: locating pin and dowel hole fits
standards_used.note: H7/p6 press fit for fixed pins; H7/g6 for sliding pins.

standards_used.name: DIN 6321 T-slot dimensions
standards_used.note: T-slot 12 mm and 14 mm most common on CNC tables.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: Pipe saddle clamp (split-band)
main_features: curved saddle wrapping half the pipe circumference
two mounting flanges with bolt holes
design_rules: saddle covers top 180° of pipe only — use intersection with half-cylinder
flanges extend below saddle at bolt_span/2
pipe bore is subtractive full cylinder
failure_modes: solid block instead of curved saddle

constraint_checks.expression: pipe bore cylinder present in difference
constraint_checks.message: Pipe saddle clamp must have a subtractive pipe bore.
